notes: Single-stage but multi-step: parse a compose-style stack file for db/user/password/published port, connect over TCP with md5 auth (wrong credentials genuinely fail), export a sorted table snapshot to JSON, and fail cleanly (non-zero, no output) on an unreachable port. Hidden scenarios reuse the deliverable against differently-configured live clusters (different db/user/password/port), so hard-coding the visible credentials fails. Small nonzero rubric for the dependency chain, psql tooling, parse/connect logic, adversarial unreachable-port input, hidden generalization and exact JSON correctness; no environment pressure or statefulness; totals bucket to medium.
